preparations.title: Sweet Potato and Red Lentil Dahl
preparations.method: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil until soft. Add the sweet potatoes, lentils, spices, and coconut milk with 500ml water. Simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft and sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in the spinach at the end until wilted.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Chicken and Peppers
preparations.method: Heat oil in a large pan. Brown the chicken thighs until cooked through. Add the onions, garlic, and bell peppers, sautéing until the vegetables are tender but still bright.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice
preparations.method: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Add to a large pot with 1.5 litres of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 12-15 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start the rice in a large pot. While it simmers, begin the dahl in another large pot by sautéing onions and adding lentils and sweet potatoes. While both pots simmer, sear the chicken and peppers in a large pan. Once the rice is done, fluff and box it. Stir spinach into the dahl and box. Finally, box the chicken and pepper mixture.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve the bell peppers and onions first, followed by the chicken, and the rice last.
